_about: next-vote.toml, read by the Pterodactyl egg's reclaimer-next-vote.py (not by Project Reclaimer itself). An admin starts a vote with !nextvote in chat or nextvote in the panel console; the winner is queued with RCON nextmap. Types follow src/renderer/lib/settings-form.js.

fields.label: Vote time
fields.help: How long players have to answer. Reminders with the standings go out at 30 and 10 seconds.

fields.label: Games per vote
fields.help: How many games of the list each vote offers, drawn at random. 0 offers them all (up to 9).

choice.label: Name
choice.help: What players read in chat. Empty: "<game> on <map>".
